# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/javascript

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/javascript

The SurrealDB SDK for JavaScript and TypeScript lets you easily connect to SurrealDB from any environment: frontend, backend, serverless, or embedded within your app. It supports connecting to remote or embedded databases, running queries, managing data and authentication, and subscribing to real-time updates with live queries.
Note
The latest version of the SDK is `2.0.4`.  
The SDK works with SurrealDB versions `v2.0.0` to `v3.2.0`, ensuring compatibility with the latest version.

##  Example projects[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/javascript#example-projects)
You can find example repositories that demonstrate how to integrate SurrealDB in a number of different environments:
[Surreal Stickies (React) A simple note-taking application built with SurrealDB, React, and Vite.](https://github.com/surrealdb/examples/tree/main/notes-v2)[Surreal Stickies (SvelteKit) A simple note-taking application built with SurrealDB, SvelteKit, and Vite.](https://github.com/surrealdb/examples/tree/main/notes-kit)[Surreal Presence (React) A demo project on how to create a realtime presence web application using SurrealDB Live Queries.](https://github.com/Odonno/surrealdb-presence-demo)[TypeScript Starter A simple TypeScript starter project using Bun.](https://github.com/surrealdb/examples/tree/main/ts-bun-starter)
##  Contributing[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/javascript#contributing)
To contribute to the SDK code, submit an Issue or Pull Request in the [surrealdb.js](https://github.com/surrealdb/surrealdb.js) repository. To contribute to this documentation, submit an Issue or Pull Request in the [docs.surrealdb.com](https://github.com/surrealdb/docs.surrealdb.com) repository.
